description:
A command line interface for the Nitrokey FIDO2, Nitrokey Start, Nitrokey 3 and NetHSM.


This release adds support for NetHSM v5.1 and for the FIDO2 minPinLength and alwaysUv features that will be available in Nitrokey 3 firmware v2.0.0.

## What's Changed
• Update for nethsm v5.1-pre1 by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/814
• Add test for hacker device when checking for genuine by @AdityaMitra5102 in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/815
• ci：Add Python 3.15 to test matrix by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/810
• ci：Lock and update actions by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/816
• ci：Use actions/setup-python instead of python docker image by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/817
• docs：Add udev rules to packaging docs by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/818
• fido2：Add pin config and alwaysUv commands by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/819
• Update dependencies by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/822
• Update for NetHSM v5.1 and release v0.15.0 by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/824


**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/compare/v0.14.1...v0.15.0

## Note for Packagers

If you package pynitrokey using the udev rules from libnitrokey, please migrate to the rules provided in the [nitrokey-udev-rules](https://github.com/Nitrokey/nitrokey-udev-rules) repository. This prepares for an update of the hidapi dependency, see https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/issues/806.
